 Discuss Portland Trail Blazers vs. Los Angeles Lakers Now!
 Talk about the hottest matchup in the NBA.
 by Dave Deckard Nov 7, 2026, 1:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 The 6-1, conference-leading Portland Trail Blazers will take on the 7-2, NBA-storming Los Angeles Lakers tonight at 7:00 PM. In recent years this matchup has evoked yawns, as the two teams have been mediocre (or worse). Not so today. Portland vs. L.A. will be the premium game on tonight’s NBA schedule and you get to talk about it live right here! This is the GameDay Thread where you can talk about the action with your friends and neighbors!
 Here’s the info on the game:
 Portland Trail Blazers (6-1) at Los Angeles Lakers (7-2) 
 Time: Friday, November 6th, 7:00pm Pacific.
 Where to Watch: NBA on Prime Video 
 How to Listen: Rip City Radio 620AM
 Trail Blazers Injuries : Vit Krejci, Shaedon Sharpe, Ja Morant, John Tonje (Out).
 Lakers Injuries: Sandro Mamukelashvili (Questionable).
 Don’t forget our GameDay Thread rules.
 Blazer’s Edge is a non-profanity site. Yes, even though referees and the L*kers exist. 
 Stay on topic in Game Day threads. There are tons of comments each evening. Adding off-topic ones here just gets confusing. 
 No trolling, please. This includes ad hominem arguments, extreme language about the game or either team, and/or repeated “spammed” comments stating the same point, among other things. Keep conversation respectful and civil. This remains true for all parties if opposing fans visit the thread. 
 No offensive language (racist, sexist, etc.) is ever allowed at Blazer’s Edge. Comments attacking or disparaging people for their inherent characteristics may (and probably will) result in immediate ejection from the site. 
 Please avoid making comparisons, analogies, etc. to hot-button issues like politics, religion, and the like. We’re here to talk basketball, at least for the duration of the game. 
 Enjoy the action! See you after the game with our instant recap and analysis!
